author: codex-ai-reviewer-s1
purpose: Independent AI visual second opinion for conservative training labels; root reviewer consolidates before saving any action.

ui_access.fallback: Read-only SQLite/API and registered PNG/GeoTIFF assets; local visual inspection.

method: First viewed all three unique raw previews without proposal coordinates.
Inspected all visible regions in full current VV/VH and historical VV views, plus enlarged dock and open-water details.
Overlaid each of the eleven configured zone geometries on exact native-UTM pixel coordinates; checked observable mask and no-data.
Read proposal coordinates only after recording independent first-pass objects.
Defined safe training subareas and explicit unknown/excluded regions; did not label entire partial zones negative.
consolidation_notes: Do not mark a full configured zone scene_complete using this report: review/training coverage is only proposed_training_reviewed_area_wgs84.
Do not export ambiguous regions as negative pixels.
Use reviewer_kind ai and record this report as provenance; never describe these as human-reviewed or independent evaluation labels.
Do not split crops from a common acquisition or its historical companion into train and test.
Family, length and width remain null.
Training subareas and object windows are proposals for root consolidation, not saved labels.

observations.summary: Se recorrió toda la porción visible del corredor. El agua central no contiene un blanco inequívoco; el extremo sur está contaminado por el retorno extendido del espigón. Se excluyen ese extremo y el borde diagonal sin datos.

exclusions.reason: Extremo próximo al espigón con retorno SAR extendido.
Margen de dos píxeles junto al límite sin datos/resampling de la huella SAR.

observations.negative_area_interpretation: No additional discernible vessel signature within the explicit safe area at this resolution; AI tentative training annotation, not certified absence.

pixel_reference.coordinate_method: Pixel edge -> exact source affine in native UTM -> EPSG:4326; not linear interpolation of preview WGS84 bounding rectangle.

historical_context.role: auxiliary visual context; not a same-date reference and not proof that a persistent object is infrastructure

limitations: AI review, not human annotation or independent external ground truth.
SAR amplitude DN displayed through preview and log1p; speckle, sidelobes and bright saturation limit interpretation.
10 m grid is not a statement of physical vessel dimensions or effective resolving power.
